note: Curated overlay for giver portraits (feature plan v7 F3), applied when the plugin builds its portrait index from the game art in the install (Tsukimichi.GameData/GiverPortraitSources.cs). crops and iconCrops: a square box ({ box: [x, y, side] } in px of the hr texture, as the design spec writes them) or a measured face ({ eyes: [u, v], chin: v } in texture coordinates, which the framing rule turns into a box: eye line at 44 %, chin at 81 % of the plate), replacing a family default or framing one icon the default frames badly. faces: a name (and era, the ExVersion row: 0 A Realm Reborn to 5 Dawntrail) for a face the game does not name, or a second name for a card drawn for one era. sharedFaces: one person on an icon that shows two or more (key "<icon>/<name>"), so each giver on a shared card wears it, through a crop of their own when the entry gives one. aliases: a source's spelling mapped to the name the givers carry. blocks: wrong matches kept out, by giver name or ENpcResident id (no icons: every portrait). pins: one giver id forced to one icon. deliveryKeys: the face seed (hr px) from which DataGen keys the emblem script out of a custom delivery portrait; the keep masks it writes are in portrait_masks/. Every entry needs a note; measure faces with `Tsukimichi.DataGen --portrait-sheet <dir> --game <sqpack> [--icons <ids>]`, whose sheets draw the eye-line and chin guides.

TripleTriadCard.note: The design spec's card box (A2.2) moved 3 px down: at y 20 the circle caught 7 px of the gold frame's crest (the contact sheet's FRAME flag).
